A '''labor camp''' on [[Kirtania]] belonged to the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]] and brought many people in to [[Slavery/Legends|Slavery]], such as [[Isshtharr]] and [[Urtuaa Haaot]]. This labor camp was eventually liberated by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], lead by [[Ran Niall]].
